card.fact_statement: House elections in the Philippines use a modified party-list proportional representation system.
card.source_span: For House elections, each voter has two votes, one via FPTP, and the other via a modified party-list proportional representation system.

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年フィリピン総選挙の下院選挙において、小選挙区制以外の投票にはどのような選挙制度が使用されますか？
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: 修正政党名簿比例代表制
target_qa_variants.source_span: For House elections, each voter has two votes, one via FPTP, and the other via a modified party-list proportional representation system.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: FPTP is translated as 小選挙区制 (single-member district / first-past-the-post) which is the standard Japanese term in this context.

backtranslation_en.question: In the House of Representatives election of the 2025 Philippine general election, what electoral system is used for voting other than the single-member district system?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The Japanese translation accurately preserves the entity, relation, and expected answer of the source question.
